scientific_question: When the exact P44 alias/archive realizations are replayed prospectively under fresh stochastic replicates, do P44 alias-conditioned cell failure frequencies predict future failures beyond a representation-vertex-specific baseline, or was the large P44 vertex×alias component itself nonpersistent stochastic realization noise?
